reason: A candidate-free target-validity audit found a major collection/operating-regime discontinuity: real all-incident daily means were 0.30 in 2023, 1.70 in 2024, and 333.73 in 2025. The originally frozen 2023-01-01..2025-06-30 q80 threshold was 33 incidents and labeled 181/184 (98.37%) July-December days positive. That target is degenerate and cannot support ranking. No candidate or baseline result had been computed when this amendment was written.

revised_observable_target.definition: For each target day d, high_workload=1 when its real all-incident opening count is at or above the empirical 80th percentile of the eight strictly prior observations having the same weekday as d; otherwise 0.
revised_observable_target.availability: The comparison threshold uses only counts known before target day d and is therefore available at the end of d-1.
revised_observable_target.minimum_history: Require eight prior same-weekday observations; all July-December 2025 evaluation days satisfy this.
revised_observable_target.mechanism: This reproducible proxy means unusually high workload relative to the recent staffing pattern for that weekday and adapts to measured regime shifts without reading future data.

revised_baseline.name: seasonal_naive_lag7_margin
revised_baseline.score: Count on d-7 minus the point-in-time same-weekday q80 threshold for d.
revised_baseline.reason: It ranks whether the most recent comparable weekday already exceeded the capacity proxy; every input is known by d-1.

unchanged_gates.primary: At least 15% paired pooled PR-AUC gain on identical real July-December 2025 days.
unchanged_gates.monthly: Win at least 4/6 monthly PR-AUC folds.
unchanged_gates.halves: Beat baseline pooled PR-AUC in both Jul-Sep and Oct-Dec.
unchanged_gates.stochastic_seeds: Seeds 11, 29, 47, 71, 101; mean passes; every seed >=10% gain; relative spread <=10%.
unchanged_gates.workload: At capacity-matched Top-20%, recall no more than 5% relatively below baseline and precision not below baseline.

operational_action: Issue a next-day flex-staffing/on-call-readiness advisory for days ranked above a threshold calibrated exclusively on prior real observations. Do not automate incident handling.
